achambhī.p: [Na+chambhī] (ti) CL=10 Having no trembling, no fear. Unshakable. Fearless . A person who is unshakable, who is fearless. See also Acchambhī

achambhī：＂အဆမ်ဘီ（တိ）

တုန်လှုပ်-ကြောက်ရွံ့-ခြင်း-မရှိသော။ မကြောက်ရွံ့-မတုန်လှုပ်သော၊ သူ။ အစ္ဆမ်ဘီ-လည်းကြည့်။
DOP: chambhi(n) mfn. [ from chambha or chambhati; cf S. stambhin, BHS chambin], stiff, rigid (with fear); (but apparently understood also as) shaking ; M I 19, 12 foll. (ye kho keci samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā ~ī bhīrukajātikā … na kho panāhaṃ ~ī bhīrukajātiko); S I 99, 1 (bhīru ~ī utrāsī palāyī; Spk I 165, 30 : ~ī ti pavedhitakāyo); Ja IV 310, 17* (so bajjhatū pāsasatehi ~ī, Ee so; Ce ~i; Be, Se chabbhi; cf 311, 30´ : catūsu pādesu gīvāya kaṭibhāge cā ti chasu ṭhānesu) quoted Cp-a 206, 7* ( eds chamhi); — acchambhi(n) , achambhi(n) , mfn. [ BHS acchambhin, astambhin], not stiff or rigid (with fear); unafraid ; M II 138, 8 (so ~ī akampī avedhī aparitassī); Th 482 (~ī ca abhīto ca vyākāsiṃ satthuno ahaṃ); Sn 42 (parissayānaṃ sahitā ~ī; Pj II 88, 21 : thaddhabhāvakara-bhayābhāvena ~ī); Ja VI 322, 11* (~ī abbhīto aloma-haṭṭho; 322, 17´ : ~ī ti nikkampo); Mil 339, 13 (amaṅku-bhūto abhīru ~ī anutrāsī vigatalomahaṃso parisaṃ upasaṅkamati); Sv 561, 8 (abhīto Ānanda tathāgato ~ī sato sampajāno āyusaṅkhāraṃ ossajī ti); Pj I 33, 26 (~-tā).
